describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, standing on all four legs. It has the overall body shape of a slender equid with a long neck, narrow torso, and long legs. Its coat is coarse and shaggy, predominantly brownish-gray with a lighter, off-white underbelly and muzzle, a short upright bristly mane along the neck, a thin hanging tail with a dark tuft at the tip, and faint irregular dark striping across the torso, hindquarters, shoulders, neck and lower legs, plus a dark dorsal stripe along the back and a dark vertical stripe over the shoulder.
